h:
为 Flux1.S 模型制作的工作流程艺术融合通量，使用助焊剂精炼剂作为升级者和细节者。

ArtFusion Flux 只需 3 个步骤即可完成准备工作
Flux Refiner 通过 6 个步骤完成最后一步

这样做是因为 Flux.1 Schnell 缺乏皮肤的一些细节，并且通常过于光滑和有光泽。

细节器/放大器的影响量可以通过降噪权重进行调整，但 0.2 就足够了。

艺术融合通量
这是仅有的 100% 纯 Flux.1 S 定制模型之一，因此它没有开发许可证。

o.en:
Workflow made for Flux1.S modelArtFusion Flux, using theFlux Refineras upscaler and detailer.

ArtFusion Flux uses only 3 steps for the prep work
Flux Refiner does the finishing touch with 6 steps

This is made because Flux.1 Schnell lacks some details in the skin and often too smooth and shiny.

The amount of influence of the detailer/upscaler can be adjusted with the denoise weight, but 0.2 is mostly fine.

ArtFusion Flux
This is one of the only 100% pure Flux.1 S based custom models, so it doesn't have the Dev license.
